briefing: Word of the Toll Road reached Ashweir inside a day. Vare's garrison commander did not send another toll company. He called up the muster.
The river runs the width of the field. One bridge crosses it, two spans wide, and Blue holds the near bank.
You do not need to take anything. You need to still be standing here when Vare gives up trying to cross.
They will not give up quickly. Eleven formations answer the muster this time, and their commander has read the reports from the Toll Road.
campaign_battle.name: Battle 2 — Ashweir Bridge
